summary: Iteration 8 — Comprehensive regression + validation of the 3 NEW admin features: (1) Admin Payments now requires partner_name (Playspintech/Harry/Bozo/Memo) and syncs partner_kasa_movements on create/update/delete; (2) Krediler renamed to 'Krediler / Kurulum' with a 'Yeni Kurulum' button that opens a wizard dialog (site + defaults seed + first credit + Telegram notify); (3) NEW /admin/rapor page with KPI cards, recharts bar chart, 4 breakdown tables, site-type filter (Tümü/Online/Sokak), date range, CSV export. Result: 37/37 backend pytest cases PASS across two files (updated test_admin_payments.py to include partner_name in payloads + 5 new partner-sync/setup/report scenarios in new test_admin_setup_report.py). Frontend Playwright covered sidebar labels, AP partner select+CRUD, AC setup dialog validations + full end-to-end setup submission (200 with correct seed/credit/telegram payload), AR page rendering + filter + far-past dates + CSV export. Zero JS console errors during the flow; the only console entry was a legitimate 400 from the duplicate-name test which triggers a correct user-facing toast.

Split across test_admin_payments.py (25 cases, updated for required partner_name) and test_admin_setup_report.py (12 new cases). Covers: unauth 401/403; blank/zero/negative amount → 400; missing partner_name → 422; invalid partner_name → 400; create/get/update/delete with partner_kasa_movement sync (Harry -3000 → swap to Playspintech -5000 → restore on delete); admin_payment_id link on movement; CSV export header includes 'Ortak Kasa' column; TOPLAM footer; /admin/setup missing name/invalid type/zero-negative amount → 400; happy path returns {site, credit, seeded, telegram} with debt=amount*pct/100; duplicate name → 400 with 'zaten var'; /admin/report defaults to current month; 2020 range returns zeros; site_type=online/sokak filters site_breakdown; invalid site_type treated as all (200); report CSV contains all 7 required sections + Playspintech header.

verifications_passed.partner_kasa_movement_sync_full_lifecycl: PASS — Backend pytest confirms: create payment with partner=Harry inserts a movement with kasa=Harry, type=admin_payment, amount=-3000, admin_payment_id=<pid>; kasa balance decreased by 3000. Editing payload to partner=Playspintech with amount=5000: Harry restored (+3000), Playspintech deducted -5000, exactly one movement per payment. Delete: Playspintech restored (+5000) and no orphan movements remain in any of the 4 kasas.

action_items: Optional cleanup: two TESTSITE_* rows remain in credits table (TESTSITE_Rapor_4f4f5c and TESTSITE_UI_1784406919). Main agent can delete them via /admin/site-credits (or add /admin/sites delete endpoint if not present). These are functional test artifacts and do not affect user data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1585 — site_type filter only accepts 'online' or 'sokak'; any other value (e.g., 'invalid') silently falls through to 'all'. This matches the spec (Query optional) but consider validating explicitly if you want to surface user error. Non-blocking.

server.py:1592-1608 — INCOME loop only counts credit_payment movements. If a partner_kasa movement lacks site_id (e.g., legacy backfill), it is still counted globally regardless of site_type filter. Consider excluding site_id-less rows when a site_type filter is active. Currently OK because all new credit_payment movements have site_id.
server.py:1547 — Turkish TRY formatter uses the same brittle .replace('X') trick as flagged in iteration_7. Consider extracting to a shared util (already exists in the file); minor maintenance debt.
AdminCredits.jsx submitSetup — pre-check on `Number(amount) <= 0` should also guard NaN (fill with 'abc' → NaN). Currently minor since inputs are type='number' but browsers vary. Non-blocking.

Positive observations: (a) partner_kasa movement sync uses admin_payment_id linkage — clean design, no orphans; (b) /admin/setup returns detailed response payload for optimistic UI updates; (c) /admin/report CSV writes sections in a consistent Turkish header order; (d) Telegram send in setup is fire-and-forget with clear ok/error/not_configured tri-state.
AdminPayments/AdminCredits/AdminReport all correctly project MongoDB `_id` out via `{'_id': 0}` — no serialization risk observed.
